title: From Detection to Mitigation: Addressing Gender Bias in Chinese Texts via Efficient Tuning and Voting-Based Rebalancing

bias_targets.methodology: Sentence-level detection and fine-grained classification of gender bias in Chinese text using a LoRA fine-tuned Large Language Model combined with a majority voting ensemble strategy. Bias mitigation is evaluated by prompting the model to rewrite biased sentences, using text generation metrics such as BLEU, METEOR, and ROUGE-L.
